Does not spit in the glass
biography: Janne, representing Revontuli Golf, has consistently graced the Hector Trophée, accumulating eight appearances in this distinguished pairs competition. While he remains an integral part of the wider Hector golfing community, he will not be competing in the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026.

Across his numerous participations, Janne has approached the demanding course with persistent diligence. Despite his dedicated efforts, neither the coveted Hector Trophée for a victorious partnership nor the prestigious Victor Trophy for individual supremacy has yet found its way into his collection. His continued engagement, however, speaks volumes of his passion for the sport and the spirit of competition.

Beyond his determined play, Janne is celebrated for a unique charm, including an amusing tendency to become temporarily waylaid on the expansive golf course grounds. His generosity is another defining trait, consistently extending warmth and camaraderie to fellow competitors. He adheres to a strict personal code, encapsulated in the memorable declaration that he "does not spit in the glass," a testament to his forthright character and unwavering principles.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 commences, Janne's absence from the competitive roster will be felt. Nevertheless, with his continued involvement in other Hector events, the golfing fraternity eagerly anticipates his eventual return, keen to observe this genial competitor once more pursuing his aspirations on the fairways with a blend of earnest effort and memorable personality.
